crop_stage_refers_to.description: Null = as the column. Filled together with a record-level crop_stage.

biotic_target.description: Null = as the column (columns[].biotic_target). Filled only when this row measures something else than its column says.

variable.description: Null = the column header (columns[].header_as_printed). Filled only when a cell needs its own wording: a split column ('RG / PH' split in two records), or a transposed table read cell by cell.

variable_standardized.description: Null = as the column. Filled only together with a record-level variable. Vocabulary. Disease, with the disease in biotic_target and the organ in plant_part: disease_severity_pct = severity as % of leaf, canopy, stem or pod area; disease_score = disease or virus symptoms rated on a scale (notas 1 a 5, 1 a 9); disease_incidence_pct = % plants, leaves, pods or seeds with symptoms (mosaic, wilted plants, dead plants from root rot); disease_index = an index combining incidence and severity printed by the authors (McKinney); disease_audpc = AACPD/AUDPC or its relative form; disease_reaction_class = I, R, MR, S, T, imune, resistente, suscetível (value_kind class); reaction_class_share_pct = % of genotypes, isolates or plants in one reaction class; disease_component = latent period, incubation, lesion number or size, sporulation; seed_infection_pct = % seeds with a fungus or virus in a seed health test; pathogen_in_vitro = mycelial growth, inhibition, germination in plates; pathogen_population = inoculum, CFU, sclerotia counts; virus_detection = % plants or seeds positive in ELISA or RT-PCR, absorbance. Pests, with the stage in organism_stage and the sample unit in unit: pest_density = aphids, nymphs, thrips or adults per plant, leaf, leaflet, flower, sweep or meter; pest_infestation_pct = % plants, leaves or pods with the pest; pest_damage_pct = % pods, grains, leaves or plants damaged by a pest, by number or mass (say which in notes); pest_damage_other = damage as a count, a mass or a score (holes per grain, damage score); trap_catch = insects per trap per period; pest_mortality_pct = mortality as printed in a bioassay; control_efficacy_pct = % control or efficacy (Abbott, Henderson-Tilton) or % reduction printed by the authors (statistic relative_to_check); natural_enemy_measure = parasitism %, predator and parasitoid counts; pest_biology = development period, survival, longevity, sex ratio, fecundity other than eggs on grain; pest_reaction_class = class of resistance to a pest (value_kind class); pest_oviposition = eggs per grain, per sample or per female (Callosobruchus on stored grain, whitefly eggs per leaflet); pest_emergence = emerged adults, count or %; grain_mass_loss_pct = weight loss of stored grain caused by the pest; susceptibility_index = Dobie index or another susceptibility index printed by the authors; repellency_pct = repellency or preference index of a choice test; nematode_measure = galls, eggs, juveniles, reproduction factor, gall index. Yield: grain_yield_area = dry grain yield per area or plot in the printed unit (kg/ha, t/ha, g/parcela), moisture basis in columns[].notes; grain_yield_plant = grain mass per plant or per pot; green_pod_yield = fresh pod yield (feijão-verde, vagens verdes); green_grain_yield = fresh shelled grain yield; pods_per_plant = pods per plant or per area (unit says which); grains_per_pod; pod_length; pod_mass = mass of one pod or of the pods per plant; hundred_grain_weight = peso or massa de 100 grãos (also of 1000 grains, base in notes); threshing_index = índice de grãos, grain over pod mass; harvest_index; relative_yield_pct = yield as % of the check (statistic relative_to_check); yield_loss_or_gain = loss or gain against a check, in % or yield units; companion_crop_yield = yield of the other crop of an intercrop (maize grain, cassava roots) in the same plots; intercrop_index = land equivalent ratio (IEA, UET), ATER, competitive ratio, as printed. Grain and seed: grain_protein = crude protein of grain; grain_minerals = Fe, Zn and other nutrients in grain; grain_chemistry = other grain constituents (starch, fibre, phenolics, tannins, antinutrients); cooking_time = minutes to cook (Mattson cooker or other); water_absorption = hydration or imbibition of grain before cooking; grain_physical = size, length, width, coat color, grain class, % whole or broken grains; seed_germination_pct = germination in a seed test; seed_vigor = vigor tests (first count, accelerated aging, electrical conductivity, emergence speed index). Plant: stand_or_emergence = emergence %, days to emergence, final stand, plants per plot; phenology_days = days to flowering, to first pod, to maturity, cycle; plant_trait = plant height, branches, main stem length, architecture or lodging score, SPAD, vigor score; plant_biomass = shoot or root dry or fresh mass; leaf_area = leaf area or leaf area index; nodule_number = nodules per plant or per root system; nodule_mass = nodule dry or fresh mass; nitrogen_fixation = N accumulated in shoot or grain, % N derived from the air, ureides, nitrogenase activity; tissue_nutrient = nutrient content or uptake in leaves or shoot (N, P, K, micronutrients); nutrient_use_efficiency = efficiency indices printed by the authors; optimum_dose = dose of maximum technical or economic efficiency printed by the authors, and the yield expected at it; plant_water_physiology = leaf water potential, relative water content, stomatal conductance, photosynthesis, transpiration, canopy temperature; water_use = irrigation depth applied, evapotranspiration, crop coefficient, water-use efficiency. Soil and other: soil_chemistry = soil analysis after the trial that compares treatments; soil_physical = bulk density, porosity, moisture; soil_biology = microbial biomass, respiration, enzymes, rhizobia counts in soil; phytotoxicity = crop injury score or %; weed_measure = weed density, biomass or control %; economic = cost, revenue, profit, benefit/cost, sprays saved; sample_size = number of plants, grains, samples or units assessed per treatment when printed per row (rule SAMPLE SIZE IS DATA); healthy_plant_count = plants or plots without symptoms, as a count; other = anything else (say what in notes). other should stay under 1%.

value_kind.description: numeric for every number; class for reaction classes, category lists, traces ('Tr') and dates printed as values; illegible for a data cell that cannot be read with confidence (value null, doubt in notes).

value.description: The number from the cell, decimal point. Null only when value_kind is class or illegible. Only changes allowed vs value_as_printed: decimal comma to point, removal of thousands separators, dropping a leading zero. A sign printed or stated for parentheses is kept (rule PRINTED SIGNS).

value_as_printed.description: The cell exactly as printed, without letters, asterisks, footnote markers or dispersion term ('2.920', '45,3', '(26,91)', '05', 'Tr', 'MS', '9/set'). The best reading or '' when value_kind is illegible.

dispersion_as_printed.description: Dispersion term attached to this value as printed ('± 0,3', '(2,1)', a standard error printed next to the mean). Null if none.

unit.description: Null = as the column (columns[].unit), then as the table (inherited_context.unit). Filled only when this cell prints its own unit.

statistic.description: Null = as the column, then as the table. Filled only when this row differs from both ('Média' row in a table of single values, a 'Total' row).

statistic_stated.description: Null = as the column, then as the table. Filled only together with a record-level statistic.

significance_letter.description: Letter(s) or asterisk(s) printed with the value, exactly as printed ('a', 'AB', 'a A', 'bc', '*', '**', 'n.s.' when printed on the value). What they mean goes once in table_level_labels.letters_meaning. Null if none.

transformation_stated.description: Null = as the column, then as the table. Filled only when this cell states its own transformation.

source_inconsistency.description: Conflict about this value only (text vs table for this cell), with both versions and pages. Conflicts about the whole table or trial go there, not here. Null otherwise.

notes.description: What the checker needs: page of the treatment key for coded rows, footnote marker on the value, the way of applying, the reason a label is overridden, the spray volume when it varies by treatment, the quoted sentence for 'text' values (at most 15 words), reading doubts. Never a value that should be its own record.

records_with_treatment_code.description: Records of this table with treatment_code not null.

records_with_name.description: Records of this table with cultivar or active_ingredient_or_input not null.

records_marginal.description: Records of this table with is_marginal = true. Equals records when main_effects_only is true.

records_of_special_rows.description: Records whose treatment is one of row_identity.special_rows.

records_of_special_rows_with_type.description: Records of special rows that carry treatment_type explicitly. Must equal records_of_special_rows.

rows_match.description: true only when every record of a coded row has treatment_code, every record of a named row has its name, every record of a special row carries its class explicitly, and records_marginal = records when main_effects_only is true.

column_id.description: Short id unique inside the table: 'c1', 'c2', ... in printed order. One entry per measured column; when the table is printed transposed (variables as rows), one entry per variable row. A column that repeats under each trial block ('Safra 1 / Safra 2') is one entry per block.

header_as_printed.description: Column header exactly as printed, joined with ' / ' from the top header down ('Produtividade (kg/ha) / Sequeiro', 'Nota de mosaico / 21 DAI', 'Teresina / PCG'). This is the record's variable unless the record says otherwise.

variable_standardized.description: Standardized variable of this column (same enum as the record). Inherited by every record of the column.

unit.description: Unit as printed for this column in the header, caption, footnotes, methods or text ('kg/ha', 'g/planta', 'vagens/planta', 'g', 'min', '%', 'nódulos/planta', 'pulgões/planta', 'ovos/grão'), read from wherever it is printed (rule UNIT FROM HEADER, CAPTION, FOOTNOTES AND METHODS) and with unit_source_place saying where. Null if none printed anywhere, or when inherited_context.unit is table (then the table holds it).

unit_source_place.description: Where the unit was read: header, caption, footnote, methods, text, or not_printed when it is printed nowhere. Methods count: a yield column headed 'Produtividade' whose unit is only in the methods ('expressa em t/ha') takes it from there.

organism_stage.description: Pest stage counted in this column: egg, larva, nymph, pupa, adult, alate (winged aphids), apterous (wingless aphids, nymphs and adults), mixed (all stages together), not_applicable (disease, yield, grain, nodulation and plant columns). Null when the column counts an organism and the document does not say the stage.

plant_part.description: Where a disease, pest, damage, nodulation or nutrient column was measured: leaves (leaflets, not specified), upper_leaves, lower_leaves, stem (caule, colo, haste), canopy (the whole foliage rated as % of area), flowers, pods (vagens), grain (grains or seeds harvested from the field, seed health tests), stored_grain (grain in storage or in a weevil bioassay), roots, nodules, shoot (parte aérea, for biomass, nutrients and N fixation), whole_plant (wilted plants, plants with mosaic), plot (rated per plot or area). not_applicable for yield, grain quality, phenology, plant trait and economic columns. Null when a disease or pest column does not print the organ.

factor_level.description: When the columns are levels of a treatment factor (row_identity.axes.column_axis_kind = treatment_factor), the level this column holds as printed ('Inoculado', 'Não inoculado', 'Irrigado', '60 kg/ha de P2O5'), joined to each record's treatment. Null otherwise.

class_label.description: Class of this column as printed, with its limits when printed: grain size or sieve class ('peneira 7', 'grãos graúdos > 0,25 g'), damage category ('vagens sem dano', 'grãos com 1 furo'), nodule size class, reaction class of a class-share column. Required when row_identity.axes.column_axis_kind is classes; null otherwise.

crop_stage.description: When this column was measured, as printed in its header, the caption, a footnote, the methods or the text ('45 DAS', '7 dias após a 2ª aplicação', 'no florescimento', 'aos 21 dias após a inoculação', 'colheita aos 70 DAS', 'após 90 dias de armazenamento'). Filled only for a column whose time the document prints; null with crop_stage_status not_printed or not_applicable. Yield and grain columns take a harvest stage only when the harvest is printed with a date, a day count or a stage (rule NEVER INVENT A STAGE).

crop_stage_refers_to.description: What crop_stage counts from or means: harvest = measured at harvest, only when the document prints the harvest with a date, a day count or a stage ('colheita aos 70 DAS', 'colhido em 15/07/2009', 'quando 90% das vagens estavam secas'); evaluation = a rating date not tied to an event; growth_stage = a phenological stage named ('V4', 'R5', 'início da floração', 'enchimento de grãos', 'pleno florescimento'); application = days after a spray, seed treatment or protectant; sowing = days after sowing (DAS, DAP when the document means sowing); emergence = days after emergence (DAE); flowering = days after flowering; inoculation = days after pathogen inoculation (DAI); infestation = days after infestation or release (weevil couples on grain, aphids on plants); storage = days or months of storage; other. Null only when crop_stage is null.

crop_stage_source_page.description: PDF page where crop_stage was read. Null only when crop_stage is null.

crop_stage_source_place.description: Where the time was read: header, caption, footnote, methods, text. Null only when crop_stage is null.

crop_stage_status.description: filled = crop_stage holds the printed time; not_printed = header, caption, footnotes, methods and text searched and the time of this column is nowhere; not_applicable = the column has no time (a lab assay with no age, a class list, an economic column). Never left out.

statistic.description: Null = as table_level_labels.statistic. Filled when this column differs ('Total' column in a table of means, an efficacy column in a table of counts is relative_to_check).

statistic_stated.description: Null = as the table. Filled together with a column-level statistic, or when the column carries its own footnote saying what it is.

transformation_stated.description: Transformation stated for this column only ('dados transformados em raiz de x + 0,5' on the count columns, none on yield). Null = as table_level_labels.transformation_stated.

biotic_target.description: Pest, disease or disorder this column measures (aphids per plant is aphids, a mosaic score is cpsmv or cabmv as named or virus_complex, % grains with weevil holes is cowpea_weevil, an oídio score is powdery_mildew). For yield, pod, grain and economic columns, the trial's target (rule TARGET OF THE TRIAL, AND OF EVERY COLUMN), never none when the trial rates a pest or disease; nodulation, protein and plant traits of a trial without pests are none. Inherited by every record of the column.

notes.description: Formula of an efficacy or relative column (Abbott, difference of two columns), the moisture basis of a yield, whether a class share is by number or mass, what a header abbreviation means and the page of its key, what a dispersion term is; at most 15 words quoted. Null otherwise.

columns_stage_not_applicable.description: Columns with crop_stage_status not_applicable. The three counts add up to columns.

columns_harvest_stage.description: Columns with crop_stage_refers_to harvest. Each one has a printed harvest date, day count or stage in crop_stage (rule NEVER INVENT A STAGE).

columns_unit_from_methods_or_text.description: Columns whose unit_source_place is methods or text.

columns_unit_not_printed.description: Columns with unit_source_place not_printed. Each was searched in header, caption, footnotes, methods and text.

methods_searched.description: true when the methods and the text were read for the unit and the time of every column, one column at a time (end_checklist.column_answers), not only the header and footnotes.

columns_differing_from_table.description: column_ids whose statistic, statistic_stated or transformation_stated differ from the table and are written on the column.

records_with_valid_column.description: Records of this table whose column_id is one of the table's columns. Must equal records.

columns_match.description: true only when the three stage counts add up to columns, every record has a valid column_id, methods_searched is true and every harvest-stage column prints the harvest.

marker.description: The footnote marker as printed ('1', '(2)', 'a', '*', 'Tr'), or 'caption' or 'note' for a note printed above or below the table without a marker.

content_kind.description: What the footnote gives (inoculation = pathogen or rhizobial inoculation of the plots).

summary.description: What it says, in our own words or at most 15 words quoted.

applied_to.description: column_ids it went into, 'table' when it went to table_level_labels, 'trial' when it went to trials[], 'none' when it holds nothing for the values (say why in summary).

dose_source_pages.description: Pages where the doses of this trial are printed.

product_treatments.description: Treatments of this trial that received a product, fertilizer or input with a dose (checks excluded).

records_with_product.description: Records of this trial with active_ingredient_or_input not null.

records_with_dose.description: Records of this trial with dose_and_unit not null.

multi_dose_cells.description: Cells of a treatment table or methods list that hold the doses of several treatments, or several doses of one product used by different treatments.

multi_dose_cells_resolved.description: Of those, how many were resolved so that each treatment's records carry only its own product and dose. Must equal multi_dose_cells.

both_forms_printed.description: true when the treatment table or methods print the dose of the products both as commercial product and as active ingredient (rule DOSE IN BOTH FORMS).

records_with_both_forms.description: Records of this trial whose dose_and_unit holds both forms. Equals records_with_dose when both_forms_printed is true.

application_count_source.description: Where n_applications of this trial comes from: printed = a number in the text or table; counted_from_design = counted from a treatment table or calendar, or a single application said in the methods (rule COUNT THE APPLICATIONS, ONE INCLUDED); varies_by_treatment_counted = each treatment counted on its records; not_printed = no number, no countable list and no single application said; not_applicable = no applied treatments.

spray_volume_kept_out.description: true when no dose_and_unit of this trial contains the spray volume.

uniform_sprays_kept_out.description: true when no record of this trial carries a uniform spray or a uniform rhizobial inoculant in active_ingredient_or_input, dose_and_unit, application_stages or n_applications (rules UNIFORM SPRAYS ARE CONTEXT and RHIZOBIAL INOCULATION IS A MANAGEMENT INPUT).

doses_match.description: true only when every record of a product treatment has its product and its own dose (or the dose is printed nowhere for it), multi_dose_cells_resolved = multi_dose_cells, both forms are carried when printed, spray_volume_kept_out and uniform_sprays_kept_out are true, and application_count_source is not counted_from_design with records left without their count.

damage_or_disease_rated.description: Does the document rate any pest, disease, damage or disorder in this trial (counts, severity, incidence, scores, AUDPC, damaged pods or grains, weevil eggs, emergence or grain loss)? Plant height, nodulation and grain quality rated as traits do not count.

rated_targets.description: The targets rated in this trial, from the biotic_target enum. Empty when nothing is rated.

rated_pages.description: Pages where those ratings are printed.

trial_biotic_target.description: trials[].biotic_target as written. Not none when damage_or_disease_rated is true.

production_columns.description: Columns of this trial that measure yield, pods, grain, plant or economics rather than a pest or disease.

production_columns_with_trial_target.description: Of those, how many carry the trial's target in columns[].biotic_target. Must equal production_columns.

targets_match.description: true only when trial_biotic_target is not none whenever damage_or_disease_rated is true, and production_columns_with_trial_target = production_columns.

methods_say_when.description: Do the methods or the text say when this variable was measured (days after sowing, inoculation or infestation, a stage, a harvest with date or count)? Read for this column, not borrowed from another variable's calendar.

methods_page.description: Page where the methods say it. Null when methods_say_when is false.

measures_damage_or_pest.description: Does this column measure damage, a pest, a disease or a disorder (counts, severity, incidence, scores, damaged pods or grains, weevil eggs and emergence, grain mass loss)? Nodulation, protein, cooking and plant traits do not.

answers_match.description: true only when crop_stage_status is filled whenever methods_say_when is true, and biotic_target is not none whenever measures_damage_or_pest is true.

record_index.description: Position in records[] (from 0) of the sample: the first record of the table.

trial_id.description: trial_id of the sample record, checked against the column block it was printed in.

treatment.description: treatment of the sample record, checked against the printed row.

unit.description: Effective unit after inheritance. Null when none is printed anywhere.

crop_stage.description: Effective time after inheritance. Null when not printed or not applicable.

pathogen_inoculation.description: Effective pathogen inoculation or infestation of the sample's plot or unit, as the trial or the treatment says. Null when none.

rhizobial_inoculation.description: Effective rhizobial inoculation of the sample's plot. Null when not printed or not applicable.

checked_page.description: PDF page reread for the check: the page of the cell, plus the methods when a value came from there.

matches_print.description: true only when every resolved value above agrees with the print for that cell.

fix_applied.description: What was wrong and which declaration was fixed (column, table or trial), in a few words. Null when matches_print was true at the first check.

second_sample_index.description: Position in records[] of the second sample (the last record of the table), checked after a fix. Null when no fix was needed.

changes_from_batata_v8: Inherited context declared once: new required table_level_labels.inherited_context with the scope and, when table-wide, the value of the six fields records inherit (unit, statistic, crop_stage, biotic_target, pathogen inoculation, rhizobial inoculation). Rule INHERITED CONTEXT IS DECLARED ONCE. Aimed at the context cascades of the health pilot (coura1987 330 records, rodriguez1984 324, camargo1984 99), the fishing pilot (mamiraua2012) and potato wolter2025 (230 fields).

One sample record per table: new end_checklist.inheritance_samples, one entry per results, figure_labeled or text entry, with the first record's inherited fields resolved, the level each came from, the page checked and the fix applied to the declaration when one was wrong. Rule ONE SAMPLE RECORD PER TABLE.

Per-column answers: new end_checklist.column_answers, one entry per column, asking whether the methods say when it was measured (potato wolter2025, 230 fields; the opposite case resende1987, 40) and whether it measures damage, so the target is never none there (potato souza1991, 27). Rules WHEN IT WAS MEASURED and TARGET OF THE TRIAL, AND OF EVERY COLUMN.
Results that look like design: rule RESULTS THAT LOOK LIKE DESIGN, with potato gomes2002 (26 records and 8 columns omitted) and tomato haji1986.
Sample size is data: rule SAMPLE SIZE IS DATA and variable sample_size (potato daniels2002, 24 records skipped by one side and 24 recorded as other by the other; fishing martins2013).
Text that contradicts a table is not a record: closed example potato daniels2004 (20 extra records, 18 unmarked conflicts) in rule TEXT VALUES.
One application counts: rule COUNT THE APPLICATIONS, ONE INCLUDED, with potato perez2001 (81 fields): fertilizer once in the furrow, a seed treatment and a seed inoculation are n_applications = 1.
Marginal only with a factorial: negative example potato daniels2002 (46 fields) in rule MAIN EFFECTS ONLY, AND ONLY WITH A FACTORIAL; survey rows are never marginal.
Dose in the stub: rule ROW IDENTITY joins the printed dose to the treatment (potato salles1999, 42 fields).
Block without number: rule BLOCK WITHOUT NUMBER, a block with its own header is its own tables[] entry (potato menschoy1974, 29 fields).

Way of applying out of the product: rule FIXED FORM FOR PRODUCT AND DOSE sends 'sistêmico', 'intercalado', 'alternado' to notes and joins alternated products with ', ' (potato gomes2002, 32 fields both sides wrong).
Mixed stub: row_label_form gets mixed for a stub that mixes line codes and cultivar names (potato lourenco2020).

Rhizobial inoculation: new trial field rhizobial_inoculation and rule RHIZOBIAL INOCULATION IS A MANAGEMENT INPUT. A uniform inoculant is trial context like uniform sprays; inoculation as treatment is treatment_type rhizobial_inoculation with the strain as input. Pathogen and pest inoculation stays in inoculation_or_infestation.
Trial context for cowpea: planting_date back to sowing_date; seed_tuber removed; new fields rhizobial_inoculation and cropping_system (sole crop or intercrop when it is not the treatment).
Columns: size_class becomes class_label (grain size, damage, nodule or reaction class), column_axis_kind size_classes becomes classes.

Vocabulary rebuilt for cowpea: grain yield per area and per plant, green pods and green grain, pods per plant, grains per pod, pod length and mass, 100-grain weight, threshing index, phenology, nodulation and N fixation, grain protein and minerals, cooking time, water absorption, grain physical traits, seed germination and vigor, the Callosobruchus bioassay variables (oviposition, emergence, grain mass loss, susceptibility index, repellency), intercrop indices and companion-crop yield, plant water physiology, sample_size and healthy_plant_count; the potato tuber terms are gone. Targets rebuilt for cowpea pests (Aphis craccivora, whitefly, Callosobruchus maculatus, pod borers and pod weevil, leafhoppers, thrips, leaf beetles, caterpillars, stink bugs, leafminer, mites, soil pests), viruses (CPSMV, CABMV, CMV, golden mosaic, complexes), diseases (powdery mildew, web blight, root and stem rots, Fusarium wilt, Cercospora leaf spot, rust, anthracnose, scab, bacterial blight), nematodes, weeds, drought and other abiotic stress. treatment_type adds seed_treatment, stored_grain_protectant, rhizobial_inoculation, biostimulant, sowing_date, intercropping and storage protection; plant_part adds flowers, pods, grain, stored grain, nodules and shoot.
